entries.alt: A small bedroom at two in the morning, lit only by the cold blue glow of a computer monitor. A bed, a wardrobe, a desk with a monitor and laptop, and a football lying in shadow underneath the desk.
A wide golden-hour sky over a river delta, with tall clouds lit orange from below and egrets rising in the distance.
A boy of about eleven striking a football on a rough village pitch beside a wide river at golden hour, friends watching from further back and white egrets lifting off the water.
A teenage boy sitting by an open window at night in the rain, his face lit green by a laptop screen. Across the dark, one window is warmly lit and a small router light glows on a sill.
A dark bedroom window looking out over a low-rise neighbourhood at night in fine rain, with a single warm lit window across the gap.
A study desk at night under a single warm lamp, stacked with admission exam books, past papers and handwritten notes, a calendar with dates crossed off on the wall behind.
A student in a grey hoodie walking with a laptop bag across a modern university campus in Dhaka on a bright hazy afternoon, glass buildings and city towers beyond.
A dark room lit only by three monitors filled with scrolling terminal text and network graphs, streaks of cyan and violet light suggesting data moving through the air.
Four blank holographic certificate cards floating at different depths in a dark violet space, edged with cyan light and surrounded by drifting motes.
An empty, well-lit workshop with three bare display plinths standing in a row under focused ceiling spotlights, and a workbench of unused tools along the back wall.
A dark wall of unlabelled game cases on a long shelf, lit entirely by magenta and cyan neon strips, with a controller resting on the shelf.

The same bedroom at dawn seen from the same angle, sunrise light falling in a long bar across the desk and floor, the monitor dark, and the worn football now sitting on the desk beside the keyboard with the floor beneath it empty.
The bedroom at night, dust drifting slowly through the monitor light.
The boy striking the football by the river at golden hour, grass moving in the wind and egrets crossing the frame.
The boy at the window at night, rain falling steadily and the laptop screen flickering on his face.
